fields.paraphrase: Himavat tells Pārvatī of the vow practiced by Candraṅgada and his wife Indumatī. The king rules Karṇa city in Mālava, knows Vedas and śāstras, sacrifices and gives generously, and has a brilliant court. Verse 3 prints aṇimādiguṇāpeta: literally free from qualities such as aṇimā. The printed negative qualifier is retained, without emending it to guṇopeta or attributing miraculous perfections. Indumatī is virtuous, serves her husband and parents-in-law, handles household duties and worships gods and guests. Ministers strongly urge the king to abandon the grievously sinful killing involved in hunting.
